description: Scan a live website URL for privacy compliance issues. Detects tracking technologies, cookies, third-party data collection, and compliance gaps by analyzing the actual deployed site. Returns a ComplianceReport with risk score, detected technologies, and compliance gaps. Optionally uses PAGEGUARD_API_KEY env var for authenticated requests.

url.description: The full URL to scan, e.g. https://example.com

name: pageguard_scan_url
